definitions.explanation: Something wrapped up, typically in paper or cloth.

examples.japanese: {小|ちい}さな{包|つつ}みを{受|う}け{取|と}った。
{紙|かみ}の{包|つつ}みの{中|なか}に{何|なに}が{入|はい}っていますか。

notes:
{包|つつ}み is a noun derived from the verb {包|つつ}む (to wrap). It refers to something wrapped up, typically in paper, cloth, or wrapping material.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {包|つつ}みを{開|あ}ける: to open a package
- {包|つつ}みを{受|う}け{取|と}る: to receive a package
- {紙|かみ}の{包|つつ}み: paper-wrapped package

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {小包|こづつみ}: parcel, small package (postal term)
- {風呂敷|ふろしき}{包|づつ}み: bundle wrapped in furoshiki cloth

REGISTER:
{包|つつ}み has a traditional, slightly literary feel. In modern everyday speech, {荷物|にもつ} (luggage, package) or パッケージ is more common for general packages. {包|つつ}み evokes something carefully wrapped, often by hand.
